|game_text=Plays on table. While you have 12 or fewer cards in hand, opponent may not remove cards from your hand (except with Monnok). Once per turn (even at start of turn), target a [Coruscant] Political Effect; it is suspended for the remainder of the turn.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[The Republic No Longer Functions]] (version 1 of 5). The image here is the slip of the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (August 2016). The current text is [[The Republic No Longer Functions (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every publication that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): Slip in the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0), official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0) PDF <code>Set-0.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 2 August 2016), page 10, slip “•The Republic No Longer Functions” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on table. While you have 12 or fewer cards in hand, opponent may not remove cards from your hand (except with Monnok). Once per turn (even at start of turn), target a [Coruscant] Political Effect; it is suspended for the remainder of the turn.” Printed: a full slip (title bar, lore and game text, with a blank area where the picture is), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•Baseless Accusations”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 8 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 4 July 2017]).</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Republic No Longer Functions (Errata)]]): Card image published 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/therepublicnolongerfunctions.gif therepublicnolongerfunctions.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref>: “Plays on table. While you have 12 or fewer cards in hand, opponent may not remove cards from your hand (except with Monnok). Once per turn (even at start of turn), target a [Coruscant] Political Effect; it is suspended for the remainder of the turn.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “•Baseless Accusations”. The PC first released this shield with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014. The PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018, so this is the earliest surviving PC card image; whether the 2014 release slip had the same words is not shown by it. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the slip above. This is the first PC card image of the card (the PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018): the whole card is drawn, with frame, picture and icons, instead of a print-and-cut slip. A visibly different publication, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[The Republic No Longer Functions (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 5 March 2022<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/79618fb/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/therepublicnolongerfunctions.gif therepublicnolongerfunctions.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/79618fb 79618fb] (5 March 2022, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Light/hires/therepublicnolongerfunctions.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d23ce93 d23ce93] (4 March 2022, “January 2022 Errata images.”).</ref>: “Plays on table. While you have 12 or fewer cards in hand, opponent may not remove cards from your hand (except with Monnok). Once per turn (even at start of turn), may target a [Coruscant] Political Effect; it is suspended for the remainder of the turn.” Printed: marked “E1”; lower-left name “Baseless Accusations”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' PC errata of January 2022 (the high-resolution image was committed on 4 March 2022 as “January 2022 Errata images.”; image marked “E1”): “target a [Coruscant] Political Effect” becomes “may target a [Coruscant] Political Effect”. The bullet is dropped from the lower-left name, and the image is re-made at a larger size. The PC published a pixel-identical copy of this image on 5 July 2022 (“fixing sizes”; file format change only, no visible change).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[The Republic No Longer Functions (Errata 3)]]): Card image published 22 July 2024<ref name="v3-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6c22b09/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/therepublicnolongerfunctions.gif therepublicnolongerfunctions.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6c22b09 6c22b09] (22 July 2024, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Light/hires/therepublicnolongerfunctions.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a546b30 a546b30] (21 July 2024, “Set 23 Errata”).</ref>: “Plays on table. While you have 14 or fewer cards in hand, opponent may not remove cards from your hand. Once per turn (even at start of turn), may suspend a [Coruscant] Political Effect for remainder of turn. If Monnok just played, may place a card from hand in Used Pile.” Printed: marked “E2”; lower-left name “Baseless Accusations”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E2” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' PC errata released with [[Virtual Set 23]] and the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref> (image marked “E2”): “12 or fewer” becomes “14 or fewer”; “(except with Monnok)” is removed; “may target a [Coruscant] Political Effect; it is suspended for the remainder of the turn” becomes “may suspend a [Coruscant] Political Effect for remainder of turn”; new last sentence “If Monnok just played, may place a card from hand in Used Pile.”
* '''PC-E4''' ([[The Republic No Longer Functions (Errata 4)]]): Partial slip in the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024-slip">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024), page 2: partial slip labelled “•The Republic No Longer Functions”. Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF itself is dated by its creation date.</ref>: “Plays on table. While you have 14 or fewer cards in hand, opponent may not remove cards from your hand. Once per turn (even at start of turn), may suspend a [Coruscant] Political Effect for remainder of turn. If Monnok just played, may place a card from hand in Used Pile.” '''Errata mark:''' this slip prints “E2” but is errata 4 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the 22 July 2024 card image ([[The Republic No Longer Functions (Errata 2)]]). The kit prints the card as a partial slip — the title bar and lore, a blank white area where the picture is, and the game-text box — with the lower-left name and the errata mark “E2” at the bottom, to be laid over a printed card. A separate PC publication that looks visibly different from the card image, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication and every visible change is a version).
